title: Cross Site Scripting/injection in WYSIWYG editor in Apache JSPWIKI from 2.10 through 3.0.0 on all platforms allows…
description: A Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the WYSIWYG editor of Apache JSPWIKI versions 2.10 through 3.0.0 on all platforms. This flaw allows an attacker to inject HTML or JavaScript code outside the textarea bounds used for rendering. The issue is fixed in version 3.0.1.
